newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ogden Aviation to handle jet link.
newsitem.headline: Ogden Aviation to handle jet link.

text.p: Ogden Aviation, a leading Schiphol handling company, has just started to handle Jet Link's cargo business.
Jet Link is a Dutch general sales agent. Customers include Air Memphis, Syrian Arab Airlines, Ghana Airways, China Eastern Airlines.
Ogden Aviation began handling the company's business Tuesday April 1. Previously, it was handled by Avia Trading.
Enrico Ouwehand, commercial manager of Ogden Aviation, said he expected Jet Link to bring 2,000 tonnes a year to the company.
He said services the company will carry out for Jet Link include warehousing, breaking down pallets, handling and documentation services.
Ogden Aviation has a 35 percent share of the passenger handling business and cargo business is expanding, he added.
Because of the increase in the company's cargo work a dedicated cargo manager has just been employed.
Edwin Schoenmakers, joined the company Tuesday from Federal Express, where he was global trade services manager in the Netherlands.
Ogden Aviation has a 7,000 sq m warehousing complex at Schiphol Airport. Cargo customers include EVA Airlines 2603.tw, United Airlines, Alitalia, Finnair and Iberia Cargo.
